said: Start wins over Stop: while both are on, if (startPressed && permissive) turns motorOn on and the else if (stopPressed || estopPressed || overload) is never reached, so Stop cannot stop it while Start is held. A stop must override the start it belongs to (NFPA 79, IEC 60204-1). items.text:
PROGRAM PLC_PRG
VAR
    StartPB : BOOL;    // NO
    StopPB : BOOL;     // NO
    EStopOK : BOOL;    // NC e-stop chain, TRUE = healthy
    Conveyor : BOOL;
END_VAR

(* Stop and E-stop override Start *)
IF NOT EStopOK OR StopPB THEN
    Conveyor := FALSE;   // stop wins
ELSIF StartPB THEN
    Conveyor := TRUE;    // seal in
END_IF;

END_PROGRAM
